title: agathosma microcarpa
intro: Agathosma microcarpa, commonly known as the Round-leaved Candleplant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rutaceae, native to South Africa. The essential oil extracted from this plant has been used to treat various health issues, including digestive problems and respiratory infections, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Agathosma microcarpa include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include limonene, pinene, and other terpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
